column1: # tools/css/gen-compute-tables.py: the closed set of computed-value sentences of the pin that the machine classifies. Columns, tab separated:
#   class (identity: the computed value is the specified value | by-type: the value types compute as Values 4 says (lengths to px, angles to deg,
#   times to s, frequencies to Hz, resolutions to dppx, math functions simplified, light-dark() resolved, urls absolute, percentages kept) |
#   shorthand: no value of its own, computed by its longhands | rule: the property carries its own row in computed_rules.tsv)
#   phrase (exactly as the pin has it)
# A phrase that no property of the pin has is stale and fails the gate; so is a property whose phrase is not here and that has no row in computed_rules.tsv.
